notes.title: Nominate Heroes of Time for its Steam Awards category
notes.notes:
Greetings, Time Travelers! We are thrilled to announce that Heroes of Time is up for nomination in the Steam Awards 2023 under the category ‘Labor of Love’. This award is a testament to games that continue to grow and evolve long after their initial release, and we believe Heroes of Time perfectly embodies this spirit.

From the moment we launched, our commitment to Heroes of Time has never wavered. We’ve journeyed together through countless updates, added new content, and made improvements based on your valuable feedback. Our creative baby has grown, but our nurturing hasn’t stopped.

We are incredibly proud of how far Heroes of Time has come, but none of this would have been possible without you, our dedicated players. Your unwavering support and love for the game have been our driving force.

So, we invite you to join us in this celebration. If you believe that Heroes of Time deserves recognition for its continuous evolution, please consider voting for us in the ‘Labor of Love’ category. Let’s make Heroes of Time’s timeless journey known to all!

Thank you for being a part of our journey. Here’s to many more years of time-traveling adventures together!"

notes.title: Heroes of Time: New Update Adds Korean, Turkish, and Arabic Languages
notes.notes:
Heroes of Time has just received a new update that adds support for Korean, Turkish, and Arabic languages. This update is a result of the feedback we received from our community. We are thrilled to make the game more accessible to players who speak these languages.

In addition to this update, we are excited to announce that a new game is coming soon as an add-on to Heroes of Time. The new game will take place in the same world and time period as Heroes of Time, but with a different protagonist. Stay tuned for more details on this exciting new adventure in the coming weeks!

notes.title: Game Update - Enhanced Experience!
notes.notes: We've taken your feedback to heart and made significant enhancements. Say goodbye to pesky typos with massive spelling corrections across all languages. Achievements are now bug-free. Plus, get ready for a fresh look with our new official logo before the game. This is just the beginning - stay tuned for exciting updates to come!

notes.title: Follow The Metthink Universe
notes.notes:
I humbly request your support by kindly following my developer page on Steam. If you enjoy my franchise and want to stay updated with all the latest news, announcements, and upcoming releases, this is the place to be. To access my developer/franchise page within the Steam game page, please follow these simple steps:

Launch the Steam client on your computer.

Search for the game title in your Steam library.

Once you've found the game, click on its title to open the game page.

Scroll down the page until you see the "Developer" or "Franchise" section.

Click on the name or logo of the developer/franchise to visit the respective page.

On the developer/franchise page, click the "Follow" button to stay connected.


Your support means the world to me, and by following my developer page, you'll be among the first to know about any exciting updates and future projects. Thank you for being a part of this amazing journey, and I look forward to sharing more incredible experiences with you in the future!

https://store.steampowered.com/developer/metthink

notes.title: Heroes of Time: Anniversary DLC - Celebrate with Exclusive HD Artworks!
notes.notes:
To commemorate the 1-year anniversary of Heroes of Time on Steam, we're proud to release our special Anniversary DLC. Featuring 80 stunning HD artworks, including 20 exclusive illustrations for each of the four main characters - Henzo, Willie, Lenna, and Aizack - this DLC is a must-have for any fan of the game. Discover new sides to your favorite characters with original concept art, action poses, and more. Available starting this Friday!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2421180/Heroes_of_Time_1st_Anniversary_Special_Exclusive_Art_Collection/

notes.title: Master Update: Bug Fixes and New Languages Added
notes.notes: We've listened to your feedback and fixed several bugs that were hindering your enjoyment of the game. Additionally, we've added Italian, French, German, and Spanish to the list of supported languages, making it easier for non-English speakers to fully immerse themselves in the game.

notes.title: Some of the fixes we've made include:
notes.notes:
- Teleportation to unknown locations has been fixed
- Achievement activation has been adjusted
- Aqala exit issue has been resolved
- Hero transparency issues have been corrected
- And many more!

notes.title: Journey Through Time: The Epic Streaming of Heroes of Time and Heroes of Time 2
notes.notes:
Get ready for an incredible journey through time with the ultimate streaming event featuring two of the most thrilling time-traveling fantasy games of all time. First up is Heroes of Time, where you'll embark on an epic quest to save the kingdom of Chronos from destruction by traveling through time and recruiting a team of powerful heroes.

But the adventure doesn't end there! Following the first game, we'll be streaming Heroes of Time 2, where you'll continue your quest to save the kingdom from destruction and encounter new enemies and allies along the way.

With stunning graphics, immersive gameplay, and an unforgettable storyline, this is a streaming event you won't want to miss. So mark your calendars, gather your friends, and get ready to embark on the ultimate adventure through time!
